pages.text: Use the manual to read. Sneak-use to open your field notes: your current objective, recorded destinations and recent discoveries or field feedback. You can also open the notes with /blacklightguide.

Lost your manual? Craft a replacement with one ordinary book and one rotten flesh in any arrangement. You can also enter /blacklightguide without the book to open your field notes and check this character's current lead.
Enter /wiki and click the link in chat to open the Blacklight Wiki. Articles list their game version. Check your field notes for your current objective.
Reference for infection stages, colonies, hosts and configurable defaults.
